He played [[college basketball]] for the [[South Florida Bulls men's basketball|South Florida Bulls]] and the [[Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball|Saint Mary's Gaels]]. ==Early life== Fitts grew up in [[Rancho Cucamonga, California]] and began playing basketball at the age of four, idolizing [[Kobe Bryant]].{{cite news |last1=Kalbrosky |first1=Bryan |last2=Rude |first2=Jacob |title=NBA prospect Malik Fitts on being an underdog and board man getting paid |url=https://therookiewire.usatoday.com/2020/11/02/saint-marys-malik-fitts-nba-draft-interview/ |access-date=November 6, 2020 |work=Rookie Wire |date=November 2, 2020 |archive-date=November 3, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201103035601/https://therookiewire.usatoday.com/2020/11/02/saint-marys-malik-fitts-nba-draft-interview/ |url-status=live }} He attended [[Damien High School]].{{cite web|url=https://www.sgvtribune.com/2015/03/25/malik-fitts-gives-damien-more-star-power-heading-to-fridays-division-iii-state-championship-game/|title=Malik Fitts gives Damien more star power heading to Friday's Division III state championship game|work=[[San Gabriel Valley Tribune]]|date=25 March 2015 |access-date=March 27, 2020|archive-date=March 27, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200327202212/https://www.sgvtribune.com/2015/03/25/malik-fitts-gives-damien-more-star-power-heading-to-fridays-division-iii-state-championship-game/|url-status=live}} He helped lead the school to a CIF Division III state title as a senior and averaged 16 points and 8 rebounds per game, earning First Team All-Inland Valley honors.{{cite news |title=Chino Hills junior Lonzo Ball leads Daily Bulletin All-Inland Valley boys selections |url=https://www.dailybulletin.com/2015/04/13/chino-hills-junior-lonzo-ball-leads-daily-bulletin-all-inland-valley-boys-selections/ |access-date=June 2, 2020 |work=[[Chino Hills Daily Bulletin]] |date=August 13, 2015 |archive-date=February 25, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220225174829/https://www.dailybulletin.com/2015/04/13/chino-hills-junior-lonzo-ball-leads-daily-bulletin-all-inland-valley-boys-selections/ |url-status=live }} Fitts opted to complete a [[postgraduate year]] at [[Brewster Academy]] in [[Wolfeboro, New Hampshire]]. While at Brewster, he committed to play college basketball at [[South Florida Bulls men's basketball|South Florida]] over offers from [[DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball|DePaul]], [[Bradley Braves men's basketball|Bradley]], [[Nevada Wolf Pack men's basketball|Nevada]] and [[Hawaii Rainbow Warriors men's basketball|Hawaii]].{{cite web|url=http://www.insidesocal.com/onpreps/2015/10/01/former-damien-star-malik-fitts-commits-to-south-florida/|title=Former Damien star Malik Fitts commits to South Florida|first=Michelle|last=Gardner|website=InsideSoCal.com|date=October 1, 2015|access-date=March 27, 2020|archive-date=March 27, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200327202954/http://www.insidesocal.com/onpreps/2015/10/01/former-damien-star-malik-fitts-commits-to-south-florida/|url-status=live}} ==College career== Fitts began his collegiate career at [[South Florida Bulls men's basketball|South Florida]]. He saw significant playing time as a freshman, playing in 27 games and starting 18 while averaging 7.4 points and 4.6 rebounds per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.rgj.com/story/sports/college/nevada/2017/04/19/usf-transfer-malik-fitts-takes-official-visit-nevada/100662822/|title=USF transfer Malik Fitts takes official visit to Nevada|first=Chris|last=Murray|work=[[Reno Gazette-Journal]]|date=April 19, 2017|access-date=March 27, 2020|archive-date=February 25, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220225174821/https://www.rgj.com/story/sports/college/nevada/2017/04/19/usf-transfer-malik-fitts-takes-official-visit-nevada/100662822/|url-status=live}} He was named the [[American Athletic Conference]] Rookie of the Week after a 29-point, 11-rebound performance against [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis]].{{cite web|url=https://www.tampabay.com/usf-freshman-malik-fitts-honored-by-aac/2312231/|title=USF freshman Malik Fitts honored by AAC|first=Joey|last=Knight|work=[[Tampa Bay Times]]|date=February 6, 2017|access-date=March 27, 2020|archive-date=March 27, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200327195821/https://www.tampabay.com/usf-freshman-malik-fitts-honored-by-aac/2312231/|url-status=dead}} Following the end of the season Fitts announced he would be leaving the program.{{cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/report-forward-malik-fitts-leaving-usf-basketball-program/|title=Report: Forward Malik Fitts leaving USF basketball program|first=Tito|last=Benach|website=[[CBSSports.com]]|date=March 22, 2017|access-date=March 27, 2020|archive-date=March 27, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200327200036/https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/report-forward-malik-fitts-leaving-usf-basketball-program/|url-status=live}} Fitts transferred to [[Saint Mary's College of California]], sitting out one year per NCAA transfer rules. He became an immediate starter for the [[Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball|Gaels]] the following season, averaging 15.2 points and a team-leading 7.6 rebounds per game and was named second team All-[[West Coast Conference]] (WCC).{{cite web|url=https://bustingbrackets.com/2019/07/25/saint-marys-basketball-malik-fitts-important-gael-2019-20/|title=Saint Mary's Basketball: Malik Fitts most important Gael for 2019-20|date=25 July 2019 |access-date=March 27, 2020|archive-date=March 27, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200327203423/https://bustingbrackets.com/2019/07/25/saint-marys-basketball-malik-fitts-important-gael-2019-20/|url-status=live}} As a redshirt junior, Fitts was a focal point on the team's offense alongside [[Jordan Ford]].{{cite web|url=https://www.sfchronicle.com/collegesports/article/St-Mary-s-Jordan-Ford-Malik-Fitts-named-to-15100726.php|title=St. Mary's Jordan Ford, Malik Fitts named to All-WCC first team|work=[[San career high 30 points and added eight rebounds in an 86–80 win over [[2018–19 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team|San Francisco]] on February 2, 2019.{{cite web|url=https://www.mercurynews.com/2019/02/02/saint-marys-gets-30-from-malik-fitts-holds-off-usf/|title=Saint Mary's gets 30 from Malik Fitts, holds off USF|work=[[The Mercury News]]|date=February 2, attempts and scored 28 total points in Saint Mary's 89–77 win over [[California Golden Bears men's basketball|California]] on December 14, 2019.{{cite web|url=https://www.sfchronicle.com/collegesports/article/Jordan-Ford-Malik-Fitts-lead-St-Mary-s-past-14907589.php|title=Jordan Ford, Malik Fitts lead St. Mary's past Cal|work=[[San Francisco high with 14 rebounds along with 17 points in a 66–60 win over [[San Diego Toreros men's basketball|San Diego]] on February 6, 2020.{{cite web|url=https://apnews.com/fe006a88a632389e72e8615bb1875465|title=Fitts, Ford lead Saint Mary's past San Diego 66–60|website=[[Associated Press|APNews.com]]|date=February 6, 2020|access-date=March 27, Fitts was named to the First Team All-WCC.{{cite press release |url=https://wccsports.com/news/2020/3/3/wcc-announces-2019-20-mens-basketball-all-conference-team-mbb.aspx |title=WCC Announces 2019-20 averaged 16.5 points and 7.1 rebounds per game. After the end of the season, Fitts announced that he was entering the [[2020 NBA draft]] and signing with an agent, forgoing his final season of eligibility.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/basketball/recruiting/Article/Malik-Fitts-Saint-Marys-signs-with-agent-145420057/|title=Malik Fitts to bypass last year of {{sic|eligibi|lty|nolink=y}}, signs April 9, 2021, Fitts signed a 10-day contract with the Los Angeles Clippers. ===Utah Jazz (2021–2022)=== On September 28, 2021, Fitts signed with the [[Utah Jazz]].{{cite web|title=Utah Jazz sign Marques Bolden and Malik Fitts|url=https://www.nba.com/jazz/news/utah-jazz-sign-marques-bolden-and-malik-fitts|website=NBA.com|date=September 28, 2021|access-date=September 29, was converted to a two-way deal on October 16. He split time between the Jazz and their [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Salt Lake City Stars]].{{cite news |last1=Todd |first1=Sarah |title=Malik Fitts earns two-way deal with the Utah Jazz |url=https://www.deseret.com/2021/10/16/22712660/malik-fitts-earns-two-way-deal-with-the-utah-jazz |access-date=October 17, 2021 |work=[[Deseret News]] |date=October 16, 2021 |archive-date=October 16, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211016222216/https://www.deseret.com/2021/10/16/22712660/malik-fitts-earns-two-way-deal-with-the-utah-jazz |url-status=live }} On January 13, 2022, Fitts was waived by the Jazz.{{Cite web|title=Utah Jazz Waive Malik Fitts|url=https://www.nba.com/jazz/news/utah-jazz-waive-malik-fitts|url-status=live|access-date=January 13, 2022|website=Utah Jazz|archive-date=January 13, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220113213332/https://www.nba.com/jazz/news/utah-jazz-waive-malik-fitts}} ===Boston Celtics (2022)=== On February 23, 2022, Fitts signed a 10-day contract with the [[Boston Celtics]].{{cite tweet|author=Boston Celtics|number=1496534679641591810|title=We have signed forwards Malik Fitts and Kelan Martin to 10-day contracts.|user=celtics|date=February 23, 2022|access-date=February 23, 2022}} He signed a second 10-day contract on March 5.{{Cite web |title=Boston Celtics on Twitter: "We have signed forwards Malik Fitts and Kelan Martin to their second 10-day contracts." |url=https://twitter.com/celtics/status/1500177429972848643 |access-date=March 17, 2022 |website=Twitter}} Fitts signed a two-year contract on March 15.{{Cite web |title=Celtics Sign Malik Fitts |url=https://www.nba.com/celtics/news/pressrelease/celtics-sign-malik-fitts |access-date=March 17, 2022 |website=NBA}} The Celtics reached the [[2022 NBA Finals]], but were defeated by the [[Golden State Warriors]] in 6 games. On July 9, 2022, Fitts was traded, alongside [[Nik Stauskas]], [[Aaron Nesmith]], [[Daniel Theis]], [[Juwan Morgan]] and a 2023 first-round pick, to the [[Indiana Pacers]] in exchange for [[Malcolm Brogdon]].{{Cite web |title=Pacers Announce Trade With Boston Celtics |url=https://www.nba.com/pacers/news/pacers-announce-trade-with-boston-celtics |access-date=July 11, 2022 |website=NBA |date=July 9, 2022}} On July 14, Fitts was waived by the Pacers.{{cite web | url=https://www.nba.com/pacers/news/pacers-waive-four-players-2 | title=Pacers Waive Four Players | website=[[NBA.com]] }} ===Ontario
